name: The Blacklist
description: Raymond "Red" Reddington, one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, surrenders in person at FBI Headquarters in Washington, D.C. He claims that he and the FBI have the same interests: bringing down dangerous criminals and terrorists. In the last two decades, he's made a list of criminals and terrorists that matter the most but the FBI cannot find because it does not know they exist. Reddington calls this "The Blacklist". Reddington will co-operate, but insists that he will speak only to Elizabeth Keen, a rookie FBI profiler.

videos.title: The Chosen One
videos.overview: Preview of the upcoming season.

videos.title: A Look Ahead
videos.overview: Showrunners Jon Bokenkamp and John Eisendrath along with Co-Executive Producer Lukas Reiter give us a few tantalizing hints of what's to come for Red, Liz and the task force in Season 2.

videos.title: Behind the Blacklist: Season 2
videos.overview: Hosted by Amir Arison, “Behind The Blacklist: Season II” is a fun peek behind the curtain of this international television hit, presented through entertaining interviews with cast and creators sharing their “insider” stories, and exciting clip packages that feature everything fans love about THE BLACKLIST -- incredible action, colorful villains, evolving characters, unpredictable storylines, and edge-of-your-seat suspense. The special will conclude with the world-premiere of an eye popping :90 trailer, which will exclusively utilize new footage.

videos.title: Season 5: First Look (Sneak Peek)
videos.overview: James Spader, Megan Boone, Harry Lennix and Ryan Eggold share a preview of what's coming up on Season 5 of The Blacklist, premiering Wednesday, September 27 at 8/7c on NBC.

videos.title: Comic-Con@Home 2020: The Blacklist
videos.overview: Executive producers and cast, along with animators from Proof, Inc., discuss how producing a partially animated episode—amid the challenges of working remotely—allowed them to complete Season 7 after production was shut down due to COVID-19.

videos.title: Like Father Like Daughter
videos.overview: An overview and look at the similarities between Raymond "Red" Reddington and Elizabeth Keen AKA Masha Rostova.

videos.title: A darker Shade of Red
videos.overview: A look into the dark side of Raymond "Red" Reddington.

videos.title: Mr Kaplan: End of an era
videos.overview: A look at the end of Mr Kaplan.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: The race to stop a terrorist begins in the premiere of this crime series about a most-wanted fugitive who works with a rookie FBI profiler to take down criminals and evildoers.

videos.title: The Freelancer
videos.overview: Red and Liz go under cover to stop an assassin known as The Freelancer from killing his next target; Ressler and a recently re-hired CIA agent try to protect Red from a distance; Liz wonders what she should do about Tom and the mysterious box.

videos.title: Wujing
videos.overview: The FBI is on the hunt for a high-ranking Chinese spy, Wujing which Red claims has hired him to help decode a classified CIA transmission. Liz, posing as an FBI cryptographer goes with Red to decode the message while protecting US government secrets. Meanwhile, Liz proactively investigates Tom.

videos.title: The Stewmaker
videos.overview: While continuing her investigation into the truth about Tom, Liz testifies against drug lord, Hector Lorca. Later another witness is abducted when he is forced to testify against the dangerous drug trafficker. Red’s interest is peaked and he informs the team that the witness may have been taken by "The Stewmaker" a man responsible for hundreds of missing and presumed dead people. Meanwhile, in an unlikely twist of events, Red and Ressler must work together for the first time.

videos.title: The Courier
videos.overview: Red and the FBI try to stop a dangerous messenger (Robert Knepper) whose appearance is unknown; Liz is thrust into a kidnapping plot.

videos.title: Gina Zanetakos
videos.overview: Tom claims he is innocent and wants to turn the box into the FBI; Red's next target is a beautiful and deadly corporate terrorist (Margarita Levieva).

videos.title: Frederick Barnes
videos.overview: The FBI searches for the man responsible for a chemical attack on a subway; Liz wants to avoid Red after he implicated Tom.

videos.title: General Ludd
videos.overview: When Red reveals a new name, Liz learns of a plot to destroy the country's financial system; Tom helps Liz when a loved one falls ill.

videos.title: Anslo Garrick (1)
videos.overview: Anslo Garrick, the newest person on the blacklist, tries to capture Red; Liz is caught in an elevator.

videos.title: Anslo Garrick (2)
videos.overview: Liz infiltrates the blacksite and disarms the signal jammers to call in backup but runs into trouble along the way. The fate of Ressler hangs in the balance as Red tries to bargain with Anslo Garrick. Meanwhile, Tom becomes increasingly worried about Liz’ situation and the fate of Red is unknown.

videos.title: The Good Samaritan
videos.overview: A serial killer from Liz's past strikes again while Red hunts for whoever betrayed him.

videos.title: The Alchemist
videos.overview: Red informs the team that "The Alchemist" - a man who relies upon science to transform a person’s DNA - has been contracted to protect a well-known mob informant and his wife. As the team goes undercover to catch him, Liz finds herself on the hunt for an unlikely couple. Meanwhile Liz and Tom find themselves at another bump in their relationship and Ressler debates whether or not he should give his ex-girlfriend his blessing.

videos.title: The Cyprus Agency
videos.overview: After a recent spate of abductions of babies from their mothers, Red informs Liz that the "Cyprus Agency" is the illegal adoption organization responsible. Coincidentally, Liz and Tom contemplate adoption of their own which fuels Liz to track down the organizations CEO, Owen Mallory.

videos.title: Madeline Pratt
videos.overview: Liz helps Tom adjust to the impending adoption; Red reveals a woman from his past is a target; Red convinces Liz to pull of a heist at the Syrian Embassy.

videos.title: The Judge
videos.overview: Red believes he knows who was responsible for a prominent prosecutor's 12 year disappearance; Red investigates the woman who tempts Tom.

videos.title: Mako Tanida
videos.overview: One of Red's former associates, a crime lord, becomes the next target; Tom decides to confront Jolene.

videos.title: Ivan
videos.overview: After a cyber defense asset is stolen by a terrorist only known as Ivan, Red and Liz discover a cover-up; new evidence regarding Jolene's disappearance unravels some of the mystery surrounding Tom.

videos.title: Milton Bobbit
videos.overview: Red and the team search for a life insurance claim adjuster who talks people into becoming contract killers; Liz and Red try to uncover Tom's secrets.

videos.title: The Pavlovich Brothers
videos.overview: As the team tries to protect a target of the Pavlovich brothers -- specialists in abductions -- Red has a job of his own for the duo; Liz patiently pursues the truth about Tom.

videos.title: The Kingmaker
videos.overview: Red thinks the Kingmaker (Linus Roache), a strategist, is responsible when a politician in Prague is framed for murder; Liz uncovers a secret Red has been hiding.

videos.title: Berlin (1)
videos.overview: After discovering the truth behind her father's death, Liz refuses to work with Red, just as his situation grows desperate.

videos.title: Berlin: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: Liz is forced to reunite with Red in order to track down Berlin.

videos.title: Lord Baltimore
videos.overview: While continuing to battle Berlin, Red faces a new threat in the form of Lord Baltimore. A figure from Red's past returns. Liz tries to move on after her showdown with Tom.

videos.title: Monarch Douglas Bank
videos.overview: A robbery provides Red with an opportunity to take down a questionable bank. Liz questions Red's intentions during the course of her investigation. An impressive addition is made to Cooper's team.

videos.title: Dr. James Covington
videos.overview: When a body is found missing a heart, Liz and Ressler join forces with Samar Navabi to investigate Dr. Covington's operation. Red and an associate try to take advantage of an opportunity in Indonesia.

videos.title: Dr. Linus Creel
videos.overview: Red thinks a dangerous sociopsychological experiment may be taking place when several previously nonviolent citizens become killers. Red has a complicated proposition for Naomi and her husband.

videos.title: The Front
videos.overview: The team targets an eco-terrorist cell seeking a deadly weapon. Liz attempts to lose her guardian. Red resorts to manipulation to pursue a special someone.

videos.title: The Mombasa Cartel
videos.overview: Liz asks Red for information about deadly wildlife poachers after a mutilated corpse washes ashore. Ressler forms a dangerous habit.

videos.title: The Scimitar
videos.overview: A plot for revenge emerges after an Iranian nuclear scientist is assassinated. Liz and Ressler wind up in a predicament.

videos.title: The Decembrist
videos.overview: Red's plans for Berlin take a sudden turn after he finds out that he was manipulated by the latest Blacklister to avenge Red.

videos.title: Luther Braxton (1)
videos.overview: When Red is arrested and taken to a secret detention facility, Liz and the task force set out to save him before he disappears forever. At the facility, Red encounters a thief with whom he shares a complicated history.

videos.title: Luther Braxton: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: As chaos ensues at the Factory, leaving the fate of Red and the task force unknown, Cooper struggles to rescue his team from the detention facility. It’s a race against time to prevent Luther Braxton attaining confidential information.

videos.title: Ruslan Denisov
videos.overview: When an undercover CIA agent is kidnapped by a band of separatists in Uzbekistan, the task force sets a rescue mission in motion. Red informs Liz and Ressler that they are up against a very dangerous former associate.

videos.title: The Kenyon Family
videos.overview: When Red tips Liz off about the disappearance of a polygamous cult leader with dangerous shipping containers buried on his property, the task force sets out to investigate. Red utilizes his sources to appease Fitch’s last words and tries to track down his hidden safe.

videos.title: The Deer Hunter
videos.overview: Red helps Liz and the task force find a killer -- the Deer Hunter -- who tracks victims like prey.

videos.title: T. Earl King VI
videos.overview: A former paramour involves Reddington in a deadly game with a wealthy, powerful family dynasty whose ill-begotten fortune was amassed from an underground auction of human and material contraband. Meanwhile, Tom takes on a new mission.

videos.title: The Major
videos.overview: When Agent Keen is questioned in court as a suspect in the murder of the DC Harbormaster, her unusual relationship with Red and their task force falls under scrutiny. Meanwhile, Red enlists Cooper and Ressler to locate "The Major," a dangerous former associate who is key in keeping Liz out of prison.

videos.title: Tom Keen
videos.overview: Evidence mounts against Liz in a murder case, triggering Red and Ressler's efforts to clear her name by tracking down the recently vanished Tom Keen.

videos.title: The Longevity Initiative
videos.overview: The task force tracks a scientist who abducts disabled patients to conduct experiments on immortality. Now back in Washington, DC, Tom scrambles to save himself from new enemies.

videos.title: Vanessa Cruz
videos.overview: The task force tracks a provocative female Blacklister, a frame-up artist who targets the wealthy elite. Tom pleads for Liz's help. Red pressures Liz for the Fulcrum, claiming it's now a matter of life and death.

videos.title: Leonard Caul
videos.overview: Red fights for his life while the task force races to track down a mysterious figure from his past while Tom provides help in an unexpected way.

videos.title: Quon Zhang
videos.overview: After decoding the information that is embedded in The Fulcrum, Red is determined to stop the imminent threat. Meanwhile, the task force discovers that deceased bodies of Chinese-American women are being smuggled out of the country under false identities. Liz continues to search for answers about her past after discovering a picture hidden in Red's secret flat.

videos.title: Karakurt
videos.overview: Following intel from Red, the FBI find themselves one-step behind the most dangerous Russian Assassin, Karakurt, an enemy on U.S. soil. To avoid catastrophe, Liz and Ressler meet with Russian Counter-Intelligence who offer insight not only on Karakurt, but also on the identity of Liz’s mother. Cooper finds himself in a compromising position.

videos.title: Tom Connolly
videos.overview: Liz realizes she is being framed by The Cabal forcing Red to use his connections to help her clear her name. As Cooper receives shocking news, Ressler, Samar, and Aram must decide who on the task force can still be trusted.

videos.title: The Troll Farmer
videos.overview: With the FBI hunting Liz for the murder of the attorney general, she and Red go on the run. Red reaches out to a contact for help fleeing the city.

videos.title: Marvin Gerard
videos.overview: With Ressler in hot pursuit, Liz only has Red to trust; Red asks a lawyer named Marvin Gerard for help with a hostage situation. The FBI wants to force Cooper out of the task force.

videos.title: Eli Matchett
videos.overview: Liz and Red take a detour to the Midwest. Ressler, Aram and Samar accidentally uncover what could turn into a global food crisis. Cooper seeks help from an unexpected source.

videos.title: The Djinn
videos.overview: Red enlists a task force to locate the Djinn, an enigmatic woman who fulfills revenge fantasies. Red and Liz believe the Djinn can lead them to the Cabal and help them exonerate Liz.

videos.title: Arioch Cain
videos.overview: Red and the FBI come together to protect Liz when a huge reward for her capture attracts attention from assassins.

videos.title: Sir Crispin Crandall
videos.overview: Red and Liz catch wind that Andras Halmi, a trusted advisor of The Director, has gone missing. In pursuit of Halmi, Red and Liz narrowly escape a violent confrontation. Meanwhile, Tom ends up in a brutal "Fight Club" to find the one man he thinks will be able to exonerate Liz.

videos.title: Zal Bin Hasaan
videos.overview: A family tragedy in Samar's past resurfaces when the Task Force hunt for an elusive international terrorist. The FBI and the Cabal gain significant ground in their search for Liz and Red. Meanwhile, Tom encounters complications in his plan to exonerate Liz.

videos.title: Kings of the Highway
videos.overview: Red and Liz are unexpectedly separated from each other when Red falls into a dangerous situation. Samar makes a risky decision to help Liz while Tom and Cooper continue on their expedition to exonerate Liz.

videos.title: The Director (1)
videos.overview: Liz awaits trial as Red and Aram take risky measures to protect her.

videos.title: The Director: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: The Cabal prepares to assassinate Liz, triggering Red's call to the task force to outmaneuver the Cabal in a bid to exonerate her. Red delivers a final ultimatum.

videos.title: Mr. Gregory Devry
videos.overview: With her name finally cleared, Liz attempts to reclaim her former life. Red works with the task force to infiltrate an assembly of high-level criminals at large in a rare, risky opportunity to capture the heads of the world's most lethal organized crime syndicates.

videos.title: The Vehm
videos.overview: When an associate of Red's is killed with a rare medieval device, Red realizes a lethal vigilante group from the Middle Ages has been resurrected; Liz considers her next move after receiving shocking news.

videos.title: Alistair Pitt
videos.overview: Red and Liz work with the taskforce to stop a negotiator who has resurfaced to unite two rival crime families. Tom reconnects with a former flame.

videos.title: Lady Ambrosia
videos.overview: After a missing child that has been presumed dead turns up alive, Red and Liz work with the taskforce to search for a dangerous woman who may be kidnapping children. Meanwhile, Tom faces shocking consequences after his plan to help Liz goes awry.

videos.title: Drexel
videos.overview: After the founder of a successful internet start-up is found dead, Red recognizes the crime scene as the work of a notorious killer. Liz and the task force work with Red to track the murderer through a dangerous underground news source. Meanwhile, Tom faces a life threatening situation, while Liz considers options for her baby.

videos.title: The Caretaker
videos.overview: After a State Department official is found dead in Beijing, Red and Liz link the murder to a secret keeper known as "The Caretaker," who maintains an impenetrable safety deposit vault for criminals. Red and Liz work with the task force to find the Caretaker and his collection of lethal and classified secrets. Meanwhile, Tom makes a risky decision, while Liz persists on her quest to find out more about her mother.

videos.title: Mr. Solomon (1)
videos.overview: After Red learns that a tactical nuclear weapon is being targeted by thieves, it's a race against the clock as the task force struggles to stop them -- and prevent an imminent nuclear disaster. Meanwhile, Tom and Liz make a decision that will change their relationship forever.

videos.title: Mr. Solomon: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: A team member falls into grave danger due to a tragedy, leading the task force to rely on Red and his unorthodox methods. Meanwhile, an unforeseen complication impacts Tom and Liz.

videos.title: Cape May
videos.overview: When a mysterious woman running from unknown assailants accidentally crosses paths with Reddington, he assists her in fighting her attackers.

videos.title: The Artax Network
videos.overview: After an unexpected loss devastates the FBI task force, they must track down their assailants; a mysterious group whose agents operate using a worldwide satellite network. Meanwhile, Reddington is forced to confront a ghost from his past -- one who knows many of Red's secrets.

videos.title: Susan Hargrave
videos.overview: When Reddington links an elegant, powerful and extremely dangerous woman to the recent tragic events, the task force is forced to play a deadly cat and mouse game to stop her before she strikes again.

videos.title: Alexander Kirk (1)
videos.overview: The FBI task force's hunt for revenge nears its endgame. As Reddington and the team close in on the mysterious arch-criminal responsible for recent tragic events, they're forced to operate outside their comfort zone – and outside the law – in order to take down their enemy once and for all.

videos.title: Alexander Kirk: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: As Reddington and the task force close in on the person responsible for Liz's death, a shocking betrayal leaves them racing to save one of their own.

videos.title: Esteban
videos.overview: After Liz is abducted by a man claiming to be her father, Red sets out to find her at any cost.  Meanwhile, the Task Force grapples with the shocking news that Liz is still alive.

videos.title: Mato
videos.overview: Red enlists Tom and the Task Force to help track a notorious bounty hunter who may know Alexander Kirk's next move. Meanwhile, Liz struggles to decide if Kirk is trustworthy.

videos.title: Miles McGrath
videos.overview: Red and the Task Force take extreme measures to hunt down one of Alexander Kirk's allies, Miles McGrath, a "criminal incubator" who finances crimes for profit. Meanwhile, Liz learns more about her family.

videos.title: Gaia
videos.overview: As Red sets Liz and the Task Force on the trail of an eco-terrorist with a mysterious connection to Alexander Kirk, Tom takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: The Lindquist Concern
videos.overview: Liz's loyalties are tested as Red takes action on an operation to intercept Alexander Kirk. Meanwhile the Task Force races to find a killer who targets inventors of revolutionary technology.

videos.title: The Thrushes
videos.overview: When Alexander Kirk contracts a mysterious group that specializes in hacking the world's most secure computer systems, Red and Liz see an opportunity to make a move on Kirk's organization.

videos.title: Dr. Adrian Shaw (1)
videos.overview: Red directs the Task Force to track down an individual who provides new identities to criminals on the run. Meanwhile, as Alexander Kirk's medical condition worsens, Liz seeks guidance from Cooper on a crucial decision.

videos.title: Dr. Adrian Shaw: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: Red pressures Dr. Shaw to locate a former patient. Liz contemplates the implications of her ties to an increasingly desperate and dangerous Alexander Kirk. Mr. Kaplan comes to a critical realization about her future.

videos.title: Lipet's Seafood Company
videos.overview: An investigation into an international terrorist operating on American soil tests the allegiances of the Task Force. As Aram faces the consequences of his girlfriend hacking into the FBI computer systems, Red cashes in on a favor.

videos.title: The Forecaster
videos.overview: A new case arrives at Liz's doorstep, where someone has left a diorama depicting a crime soon to be committed. Meanwhile, Red explores a new business opportunity.

videos.title: The Harem
videos.overview: Liz must prove herself to the leader of an elite group of female thieves in order to infiltrate their organization as they prepare for their next heist. Meanwhile, Red contends with unexpected problems in his operations, and Tom channels his energy into fatherly duties.

videos.title: Natalie Luca
videos.overview: After discovering his criminal empire is under attack, Red turns to the task force for help, leading the team to hunt an assassin who kills her victims by infecting them with a lethal disease. Meanwhile, Red enlists Tom in an undercover operation.

videos.title: Isabella Stone
videos.overview: As another member of Red's team is targeted, the task force races to stop the sophisticated criminal who has been attacking Red and his businesses. Meanwhile, a shocking event sends Tom on the hunt for information about his past.

videos.title: The Architect
videos.overview: Aram goes under cover as a hacker to find a criminal who designs and executes crimes for a price.

videos.title: The Apothecary
videos.overview: After being dosed with poison, Red must retrace his steps to discover which of his closest allies has betrayed him, while the task force races against the clock to find an antidote that will save him.

videos.title: Dembe Zuma
videos.overview: After weeks of hunting for Dembe, Red and the Task Force finally get a lead on his whereabouts when Aram goes missing. Meanwhile, Dembe takes a calculated risk as Red closes in.

videos.title: Requiem
videos.overview: Memories of the past set Red on a dangerous collision course with an enemy determined to destroy his criminal empire.

videos.title: Philomena
videos.overview: The Task Force chases an artful bounty hunter employed to target Red's closest associates. Meanwhile, Ressler faces a moral dilemma when he takes on a new assignment with a former colleague.

videos.title: Dr. Bogdan Krilov
videos.overview: Red sets the Task Force on the trail of a Blacklister with the tools to manipulate memories, causing Liz to question her own experiences. As Gale intensifies his investigation, Ressler receives a new lead on the disappearance of Justice Department official Reven Wright.

videos.title: The Debt Collector
videos.overview: When Liz becomes the target of a mercenary known as the Debt Collector, Red turns to an unlikely source for help. Meanwhile, Ressler faces an unexpected complication in his efforts to stay ahead of Agent Gale's investigation.

videos.title: Mr. Kaplan (1)
videos.overview: Red tracks a high-end thief enlisted by Mr. Kaplan for a mysterious assignment. Aram faces a tough decision when agent Gale goes to extreme measures in his investigation into the Task Force's conduct.

videos.title: Mr. Kaplan: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: Red sets a dangerous plan in motion to save himself and the Task Force as Kaplan engages in the final phase of her assault on his criminal empire. With the future of the Task Force in jeopardy, Liz confronts the biggest questions about her past.

videos.title: Smokey Putnum
videos.overview: With his criminal empire in ruins, Red enlists Liz in a plan to earn cash and deliver a new Blacklister to the Task Force.

videos.title: Greyson Blaise
videos.overview: Liz and the Task Force join Red on an international adventure in pursuit of a billionaire who moonlights as a high end art thief. Meanwhile, Dembe chases a lead and Tom seeks outside help in identifying the remains in the suitcase.

videos.title: Miss Rebecca Thrall
videos.overview: While the Task Force investigates a series of suspicious police shootings, Agent Ressler is distracted by increasing external pressures. With his back up against the wall, Red drafts Tom in executing an elaborate plan to help re-establish his criminal reputation.

videos.title: The Endling
videos.overview: Liz and the Task Force hunt for an elusive criminal who will stop at nothing to destroy some of the world's most precious treasures. Meanwhile, a surprise encounter leads a cash-strapped Red toward a new business opportunity, and Tom takes action to investigate the bones in the suitcase.

videos.title: Ilyas Surkov
videos.overview: When Red provides exclusive intel on an international terrorist, it puts Liz and the Task Force on a collision course with a rival unit from the CIA. Meanwhile, Red and Hawkins lay the groundwork for their new business venture, and Tom goes undercover in search of information.

videos.title: The Travel Agency
videos.overview: While Cooper enlists Red on a case of personal importance, Ressler leads the Task Force on a mission to stop the resurgence of once-dormant murder-for-hire ring. Determined to find answers, Tom disregards a warning to halt his investigation into the suitcase.

videos.title: The Kilgannon Corporation
videos.overview: Red and the Task Force place Dembe undercover to infiltrate an international human smuggling organization, but when communication is lost, they must intervene. Meanwhile, Tom's investigation into the suitcase lands him in grave danger.

videos.title: Ian Garvey
videos.overview: Tom goes missing and Liz desperately retraces his steps to find him. Red's hunt for the suitcase of bones leads to lives being changed forever.

videos.title: Ruin
videos.overview: Liz abandons her old life and seeks out a fresh start in a place where no one knows her history, her name, or the depths of her grief. When an unexpected threat finds her, she is forced to draw on her emotional and physical strength in a brutal fight for survival.

videos.title: The Informant
videos.overview: When Red directs the Task Force to find a Blacklister who uses his position of power to sell sensitive information, Ressler finds himself at risk of exposure. Meanwhile, Liz plans her next move.

videos.title: Abraham Stern
videos.overview: When Red goes on the hunt for a legendary treasure, he draws the attention of Abraham Stern, a cunning manipulator who has devoted his life - and the lives of many innocents - to recovering the fortune that is his birthright. Meanwhile, Liz's quest sends her down a dark path, leading her to study the methods of one of the Blacklist's most dangerous criminals.

videos.title: The Cook
videos.overview: As Liz works with Red to hunt for Tom's killers, she begins to question his motives. The Task Force enlists the help of one arsonist to catch another.

videos.title: The Invisible Hand
videos.overview: When bodies are discovered in abandoned woods, Red points the Task Force toward The Invisible Hand, a group that targets those whose actions are morally reprehensible yet fully legal. Meanwhile, Red steps in to assist one of his employees, and Liz discovers a major clue about Tom's investigation.

videos.title: Mr. Raleigh Sinclair III
videos.overview: Red assists the Task Force in tracking a mysterious Blacklister who carefully develops airtight alibis for murderous clients. Meanwhile, Liz's reinstatement at the FBI hinges on an evaluation with a psychotherapist.

videos.title: Pattie Sue Edwards
videos.overview: As Liz continues tracking Tom's killers, Red tries to solve a tax issue in his money laundering. Meanwhile, Aram goes out to the field when the Task Force investigates a viral outbreak.

videos.title: The Capricorn Killer
videos.overview: As Liz investigates new details in a cold case from her early work as an FBI profiler, she explores her darker impulses in therapy with Dr. Fulton. The Task Force takes action to bring down Tom's killers within the legal system, while Red takes a different approach to closing in on Ian Garvey.

videos.title: Anna-Gracia Duerte
videos.overview: When an associate of the Nash Syndicate is murdered, Red sets Liz and the Task Force on the case in order to recover evidence crucial to bringing down Ian Garvey. Meanwhile, Aram considers a step forward in his relationship with Samar.

videos.title: Zarak Mosadek
videos.overview: In an attempt to apply pressure to Ian Garvey, Red and the Task Force head to Paris to track down a prominent heroin supplier for the Nash Syndicate. Distrustful of Red's agenda, Liz takes her own path in going after Garvey.

videos.title: Ian Garvey: Conclusion
videos.overview: Liz uses intel from an unexpected source to force Red to uncover the secrets he holds. Red initiates a plan to retrieve the duffel bag of bones.

videos.title: Nicholas T. Moore
videos.overview: An unidentified young girl reappears and the team tries to find her connection to the secret Red is hiding. When her family steps in to protect their own secrets, the investigation turns into a race to save the girl's life.

videos.title: Lawrence Dane Devlin
videos.overview: Samar lands in the crosshairs of an unconventional Blacklister, and Aram and the task force spring into action to find her before it's too late. Red journeys to Costa Rica to prevent the duffel bag of bones from being sold at an underground auction.

videos.title: Sutton Ross
videos.overview: Liz and Red face off in a climactic race to find a Blacklister in possession of the duffel bag of bones, forcing the truth about the bones to finally come to light.

videos.title: Dr. Hans Koehler
videos.overview: Red presents the Task Force with a Blacklist case searching for a plastic surgeon who creates new identities for wanted criminals. Liz and her sister, Jennifer, secretly investigate the events that took place the night the real Raymond Reddington died.

videos.title: The Corsican
videos.overview: As Liz and the Task Force race to stop an imminent bombing by an elusive Blacklister, Red has an encounter that will change the trajectory of his life forever.

videos.title: The Pharmacist
videos.overview: While Liz and the Task Force track a notorious underground biohacker, Red initiates a strategy to extricate himself from a problematic position. Meanwhile, Cooper's integrity is tested with a difficult choice.

videos.title: The Pawnbrokers
videos.overview: Red acclimates to his new surroundings in federal prison, where he is challenged by an old rival. Samar goes undercover to stop a black market organization that fronts cash to criminals. Meanwhile, Liz and Jennifer continue their investigation into Red's past.

videos.title: Alter Ego
videos.overview: While Red argues in court to uphold the validity of his immunity agreement, Liz and the Task Force question a man whose recent inheritance seems too good to be true and Dembe offers Red some advice.

videos.title: The Ethicist
videos.overview: When Red is sent to a federal medical institution following his request to the court for a psychiatric evaluation, Liz and Jennifer use his time away to search for a Blacklister they believe may have valuable information about Red's past.

videos.title: General Shiro
videos.overview: While Red and Dembe enlist Glen's help in stacking the jury to Red's advantage for his upcoming trial, the task force investigates a series of mysterious deaths resulting from weaponized insects.

videos.title: Marko Jankowics
videos.overview: Liz and Jennifer's pursuit of a lead on the truth about Reddington puts them in unexpected danger. Red steps in to help mediate a brewing prison gang war.

videos.title: Minister D
videos.overview: As his trial begins, Red puts Liz and the task force on the case of a Blacklister who uses incriminating evidence to extort people -- and who Red believes can prove his innocence.

videos.title: The Cryptobanker
videos.overview: The Task Force delves into the unregulated world of cryptocurrency in order to stop an impending attack, while Red undertakes a risky endeavor in order to secure his freedom.

videos.title: Bastien Moreau (1)
videos.overview: Liz and the task force make a play to uncover the truth about an international assassination in a last-ditch effort to save Red's life.

videos.title: Bastien Moreau: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: Cooper puts his reputation on the line to appeal to the White House on Red's behalf, as Liz and the task force resume their search for The Corsican, a Blacklister with ties to an international conspiracy. Samar's abilities in the field are tested.

videos.title: Robert Vesco
videos.overview: Red and the task force hunt for legendary fugitive Robert Vesco, one of history's most notorious con men. Samar makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: The Osterman Umbrella Company
videos.overview: Red directs Liz to investigate a secret organization of assassins hired by global intelligence agencies to eliminate former agents, a case with ramifications that will change the task force forever.

videos.title: Olivia Olson
videos.overview: The Task Force searches for a woman who specializes in hostile takeovers of criminal organizations, and may have intelligence connected to an international conspiracy involving presidential advisor Anna McMahon. Meanwhile, Aram enacts a daring plan to gain leverage over Red.

videos.title: Lady Luck
videos.overview: Liz and Ressler investigate a Blacklister who offers to erase gambling debts -- at a deceptively high price. Dembe grows concerned as Red tests loyalties of their business associates in search of the individual who turned him in to the police.

videos.title: The Third Estate
videos.overview: Red and the task force spring into action to stop an anti-capitalist terrorist group from kidnapping and torturing the children of the one percent. Ressler goes behind Liz's back to find out what happened to her mother, Katarina Rostova.

videos.title: The Brockton College Killer
videos.overview: The task force is drawn into the investigation of an old case that has gained notoriety due to a popular true crime podcast. Red visits Dom Wilkinson for help making a difficult decision. Ressler makes a discovery about Katarina Rostova's past.

videos.title: Rassvet
videos.overview: Alone in a foreign country after a mission goes catastrophically wrong, Katarina Rostova goes on the run to avoid the forces trying to hunt her down.

videos.title: Guillermo Rizal
videos.overview: When multiple children are abducted under similar circumstances, the Task Force rushes to find the kidnapper. Meanwhile, Red goes on the hunt for a man who can find anything, while Liz considers a big change.

videos.title: Anna McMahon
videos.overview: Presidential adviser Anna McMahon faces off with Cooper and the task force in a winner-takes-all race to locate the missing dossier containing details of a conspiracy against America.

videos.title: Robert Diaz
videos.overview: As the president's true plan comes into focus, Liz and the task force fight to avert disaster. Red meets in secret with a man who holds information about his past.

videos.title: Louis T. Steinhil (1)
videos.overview: After being abducted by Katarina Rostova, Raymond "Red" Reddington finds himself alone in hostile territory unsure of who, if anyone, he can trust. With few leads to go on, Liz and the Task Force venture into unknown danger as they race to find him.

videos.title: Louis T. Steinhil: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: Liz, Dembe and the Task Force continue to search for Red. Red attempts to escape his abductors with help from a surprise ally, but discovers he is not Katarina Rostova's only target in her hunt for information.

videos.title: Les Fleurs du Mal
videos.overview: Aram goes undercover to infiltrate a secret society of wealthy thrill-seekers, whose entertainment hinges upon spectacular acts of violence. Meanwhile, Red tries to negotiate with a former associate involved in the Townsend Directive, while Katarina Rostova takes steps to insinuate herself into Liz's life.

videos.title: Kuwait
videos.overview: Cooper's moral compass is tested when an officer whom he served with as young man, long presumed to be dead, resurfaces as a POW.

videos.title: Norman Devane
videos.overview: Liz and the Task Force investigate an infamous assassin who has a long history of weaponizing diseases, but has now turned to even more insidious activities. Meanwhile, Red and Dembe travel to Cuba in search of a lead, and Aram considers a new relationship.

videos.title: Dr. Lewis Powell
videos.overview: Red alerts the FBI to the suspicious death of a scientist specializing in artificial intelligence research. Meanwhile, Francesca Campbell further entangles herself in Red's criminal activities

videos.title: Hannah Hayes
videos.overview: The Task Force investigates the unexplained disappearance and sudden re-emergence of a governor. Meanwhile, Red and Dembe surveil someone close to Katarina Rostova, as she inadvertently involves Agnes in an operation of her own.

videos.title: The Hawaladar
videos.overview: Desperate for information about the whereabouts of a longtime friend, Red directs the Task Force to find a blacklister who specializes in untraceable money transfers. Meanwhile, Liz receives some disturbing news from her daughter Agnes.

videos.title: Orion Relocation Services
videos.overview: Red and Liz investigate Orion Relocation Services, an organization that surreptitiously facilitates the disappearance and relocation of criminals. Meanwhile, Katarina delves into the memories of an old friend in order to get additional information about the Townsend Directive.

videos.title: Katarina Rostova
videos.overview: Red and the Task Force pay a visit to a former blacklister, as an explosive confrontation leads Liz to make a critical choice

videos.title: Victoria Fenberg
videos.overview: With the help of the Task Force, Red tracks a gifted art forger who has thwarted his plans to sell stolen pieces. Aram’s love life becomes increasingly complicated. Liz and Ressler confide in each other.

videos.title: Cornelius Ruck
videos.overview: Secluded on a private island, Red reunites with an old flame and a ring of thieves in a plot to make millions off stolen art. Plans are quickly derailed, however, when guests on the island mysteriously show up dead.

videos.title: Newton Purcell
videos.overview: The Task Force investigates a series of attacks on data centers perpetrated by a blacklister with a peculiar condition, as Liz conducts a secret investigation on the side. Meanwhile, Glen desperately tries to prove his value to Red after a shipping mishap.

videos.title: Twamie Ullulaq
videos.overview: A Blacklist case becomes personal for Agent Park when the team investigates a mysterious disappearance in the Alaska Triangle. Meanwhile, Aram enlists Red’s help to find out what really happened to Elodie’s husband.

videos.title: Gordon Kemp
videos.overview: A blacklist case forces Liz to choose sides between Red and the Task Force. Meanwhile, Red tries to calm a panicked Ilya Koslov, who believes he is under surveillance.

videos.title: Nyle Hatcher
videos.overview: Liz and the Task Force take on a cold case that may have some new victims. Meanwhile, Red tries to help a friend of Dembe who is in danger.

videos.title: Brothers
videos.overview: Ressler is forced to confront past trauma and family secrets when his brother takes him back home for a risky job.

videos.title: Roy Cain
videos.overview: As the Task Force investigates a kidnapping executed by seemingly impossible abductors, Dembe lands in a perilous situation. Meanwhile, a recent health scare causes Red to think about a successor.

videos.title: The Kazanjian Brothers
videos.overview: The Task Force investigates an accountant who works for lucrative criminals in order to find the violent and thuggish brothers hired for his protection. Meanwhile, Liz must make a momentous decision.

videos.title: Roanoke
videos.overview: Red directs the task force to investigate Roanoke, a legendary criminal who orchestrates elaborate extractions. Meanwhile, Liz works to hatch a secret plan with her mother, Katarina Rostova.

videos.title: Katarina Rostova: Conclusion
videos.overview: As Liz pushes a source for answers, Red and the task force grapple with the implications of her actions. Tensions boil over and a drastic action is taken, which will change Red and Liz's relationship forever.

videos.title: 16 Ounces
videos.overview: Fueled by his betrayal, Elizabeth Keen seeks vengeance on Reddington.

videos.title: Elizabeth Keen
videos.overview: As Red and the task force search for Liz, she sets a new plan in motion that has catastrophic consequences.

videos.title: The Fribourg Confidence
videos.overview: The task force investigates an organization of bank robbers with a special expertise in stealing from other criminals. An old blacklist case resurfaces.

videos.title: The Wellstone Agency
videos.overview: Red and Dembe go to great lengths to fulfill the final wishes of a dear friend. Aram goes undercover as an interpreter to a company that provides services to criminals, while Park helps a friend in trouble.

videos.title: Chemical Mary
videos.overview: The task force must race to stop simultaneous danger presented by two blacklisters. Cooper approaches a congressman for intel.

videos.title: Ogden Greeley
videos.overview: The task force investigates the apparent disappearance of a defense contractor. Cooper receives an unexpected offer and Red makes a connection.

videos.title: The Cyranoid
videos.overview: The task force is thrown for a loop when they encounter a nefarious enterprise that provides doppelgängers for criminals. Red scrambles to counteract a bold move by Liz.

videos.title: Dr. Laken Perillos
videos.overview: Red and Dembe land in peril when Townsend deploys a torture specialist who uses unorthodox methods to interrogate her victims.

videos.title: Captain Kidd
videos.overview: The task force attempts to stop an abduction by searching for a "treasure man" who uses geocaching to hide illicit goods and facilitate transactions between otherwise warring criminal factions.

videos.title: Rakitin
videos.overview: The task force's determination to identify a Russian asset in the U.S. government puts Cooper and Reddington in increasingly treacherous positions.

videos.title: Anne
videos.overview: Red enjoys a quiet visit with a friend at her home in rural America.

videos.title: Misère
videos.overview: In a retrospective look at key turning points, steps are retraced that lead Elizabeth Keen to align with a powerful enemy.

videos.title: The Russian Knot
videos.overview: The Task Force hatches a plan to steal a Soviet-era cipher machine needed to decrypt coded messages. Townsend puts Liz's loyalty to the test. Red and Dembe are called to an unexpected meeting.

videos.title: Nicholas Obenrader
videos.overview: Liz and the Task Force track new leads in their investigation of N-13, while Red takes steps to infiltrate Townsend's criminal organization.

videos.title: Ivan Stepanov
videos.overview: Red tries desperately to rescue an old friend at all costs, while Liz and Townsend conduct an interrogation.

videos.title: The Protean
videos.overview: The Task Force springs into action to stop an elusive assassin on Liz's trail.

videos.title: Balthazar "Bino" Baker
videos.overview: Hoping to move some precious cargo quietly, Red enlists the assistance of an enforcer who specializes in transporting items through an underground network.

videos.title: Godwin Page
videos.overview: Liz, Red and Dembe are forced to work together to survive an attack from Townsend. Cooper and the Task Force attempt to de-escalate the increasing danger to all.

videos.title: Nachalo
videos.overview: When Reddington takes Liz to the mysterious epicenter of his empire, their shared past reveals itself and long buried secrets are divulged.

videos.title: Konets
videos.overview: Reddington makes a disturbing request to Liz in exchange for the truth about his identity.

videos.title: The Skinner (1)
videos.overview: In the two years following the death of Elizabeth Keen, Raymond Reddington and the members of the FBI Task Force have disbanded with Reddington's whereabouts unknown. When one of their own is injured in the line of duty, however, the Task Force is drawn back together to bring down a conspiracy that could shatter global security.

videos.title: The Skinner: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: A kidnapping poses a test for the capabilities of the Task Force as they contend with a mysterious pirating organization.

videos.title: The SPK
videos.overview: A new case involving stolen artifacts reunites Red with a former blacklister. Aram faces a difficult decision.

videos.title: The Avenging Angel
videos.overview: The Task Force races to locate a blacklister who uses any means necessary to return what has been unjustly stolen. Ressler asks Park for a favor. Cooper tries to piece together an event for which he has no memory.

videos.title: Benjamin T. Okara
videos.overview: Dembe's position as an FBI agent causes complications for Red as the Task Force handles a case involving military technology. Cooper and Park each find their personal lives increasingly complicated.

videos.title: Dr. Roberta Sand, Ph.D.
videos.overview: The Task Force investigates a therapist who may be the key to the resurgence of an organized crime family. Red conducts an investigation of his own.

videos.title: Between Sleep and Awake
videos.overview: In a series of flashbacks, Ressler recalls his actions in the aftermath of Elizabeth Keen's death.

videos.title: Dr. Razmik Maier
videos.overview: The death of a professional tennis player leads the Task Force to a doctor who may be fixing the odds for a major sports betting syndicate. Red digs deeper into Dembe's betrayal. Ressler struggles with sobriety.

videos.title: Boukman Baptiste
videos.overview: A spate of coordinated attacks on Red's lieutenants puts Dembe in imminent danger, prompting him to relive the events that led him to join the FBI two years earlier.

videos.title: Arcane Wireless
videos.overview: The task force's investigation into Arcane Wireless, an untraceable cellular network for criminals, leads to unexpected consequences. Red races against the clock to get a colleague out of trouble.

videos.title: The Conglomerate
videos.overview: An investigation into the Conglomerate, a group of former government-sponsored assassins, becomes complicated when the Task Force learns one of their own may have ties to the group. Red digs deeper into the events leading up to Liz's death.

videos.title: The Chairman
videos.overview: The Task Force pursues their latest target, the Chairman, who operates a dark web stock market trading shares of criminal organizations. Red takes extreme measures to locate a tracking device, which sends Ressler into a spiral. Cooper makes contact with his blackmailer.

videos.title: Genuine Models, Inc.
videos.overview: The Task Force is led to an unusual suspect when the wealthy clients of an apparent escort service start turning up dead. Red and a friend attempt to recover an item after reuniting at a friend's memorial. Cooper heads to Atlanta to follow a lead on his blackmailer.

videos.title: Eva Mason
videos.overview: While searching for Sen. Panabaker's missing daughter-in-law, the Task Force learns there may be a larger pattern of abductions. Red continues piecing together the mystery behind Liz's death.

videos.title: Andrew Kennison
videos.overview: Tensions rise when Cooper’s search for his blackmailer overlaps with the Task Force’s latest Blacklist case.

videos.title: Helen Maghi
videos.overview: Red chases a lead that could shed light on both Liz’s death and Cooper’s blackmailing. The Task Force experiences a major shakeup when one of their own is taken into custody.

videos.title: El Conejo
videos.overview: When a member of The Task Force is captured by the leader of a cartel, they turn to Red for guidance. Red investigates a seemingly impossible heist.

videos.title: Laszlo Jankowics
videos.overview: Red questions the whereabouts of a former associate. The Task Force hunts down a criminal dealing in illegal psychedelics.

videos.title: The Bear Mask
videos.overview: Feeling the weight of recent pressures, Aram turns to an unusual outlet for release.

videos.title: Caelum Bank
videos.overview: In an effort to reveal his true enemy, Red turns to the Task Force to help ground a flying fortress bank.

videos.title: Marvin Gerard: Conclusion (1)
videos.overview: Red and the Task Force spring into action after learning who betrayed them.

videos.title: Marvin Gerard: Conclusion (2)
videos.overview: Red and Cooper square off with conflicting endgames for their mutual traitor. A major secret about the Task Force falls into the wrong hands.

videos.title: The Night Owl
videos.overview: Six months after Wujing's escape from custody, Reddington mysteriously resurfaces in Manhattan amidst an explosion. When a former Blacklister is found at the scene, the Task Force begins to investigate a larger conspiracy at play.

videos.title: The Whaler
videos.overview: The Task Force works to infiltrate a high-stakes poker game tied to Wujing with the help of new team member Siya Malik. Red and Cooper have opposing tactics when Agnes is bullied at school.

videos.title: The Four Guns
videos.overview: An assassination attempt on Sen. Panabaker leads the Task Force to a group of renowned pickpockets. Red sends a dangerous gift to an old friend in custody.

videos.title: The Hyena
videos.overview: Red attempts to secure a late financier's fortune locked by a series of challenging clues. When a deadly assassin pursues the money, the Task Force bands together to protect the endowment's rightful heirs.

videos.title: The Dockery Affair
videos.overview: An investigation surrounding the murder of a judge sheds new light on an unsolved case. Red's relationship with a trusted colleague is put in a precarious position when his cooperation with the FBI is disclosed.

videos.title: Dr. Laken Perillos: Conclusion
videos.overview: When Dr. Laken Perillos resurfaces to join Wujing's crusade against Red, a member of The Task Force is put in danger.

videos.title: The Freelancer (2)
videos.overview: The return of The Freelancer unveils a conspiracy involving a local photographer. Ressler hits a personal milestone.

videos.title: The Troll Farmer (2)
videos.overview: The Task Force investigates a series of social media conspiracies that simulate dangerous public attacks. When a top-secret government program is stolen, the team works to uncover the Troll Farmer's involvement.

videos.title: The Troll Farmer (3)
videos.overview: The Task Force races against the clock to recover a valuable asset stolen from the US government. Red hatches a plan to help track down the perpetrators.

videos.title: The Postman
videos.overview: After an inmate opens fire at a high-security prison, the Task Force investigates a contraband smuggler known as The Postman. Cooper revisits his past ties to the suspect.

videos.title: The Man in the Hat
videos.overview: When Red is identified as a possible hostage during a deli robbery in Philadelphia, Dembe and Ressler take action. Back in D.C., Sen. Panabaker evaluates The Task Force's dealings with Red while Siya digs deeper into her mother's past.

videos.title: Dr. Michael Abani
videos.overview: Dembe reflects on his complicated past when he receives a concerning call from an old connection. An ambitious Congressman begins to question the Task Force's operations.

videos.title: The Sicilian Error of Color
videos.overview: While accompanying Red on a series of unusual tasks, Siya learns more about Meera's past. Congressman Hudson attempts to persuade a powerful friend to join his crusade against The Task Force.

videos.title: The Nowhere Bride
videos.overview: The task force investigates the whereabouts of a missing newlywed. Red offers his help to a powerful cartel leader. Siya visits a connection from her mother's past.

videos.title: The Hat Trick
videos.overview: In an effort to prove their worth to Congressman Hudson, Red provides the task force with three criminal cases that are deeper than they appear. Ressler helps a friend make amends.

videos.title: Blair Foster
videos.overview: When a corrupt lawyer is linked to a string of corporate cover-ups, Red helps the team investigate her operation. Sen. Panabaker and Cooper await a judge's decision on the fate of the task force.

videos.title: The Morgana Logistics Corporation
videos.overview: The Task Force encounters a ring of fraudulent companies shipping contraband around the world. Congressman Hudson's investigation escalates when he recruits help from within the FBI.

videos.title: Wormwood
videos.overview: Red's attempt to mediate a meeting between two rival families takes a deadly turn. When an elusive criminal is linked to the incident, the task force races against time to save Red and his associates.

videos.title: Room 417
videos.overview: A cryptic tip from Red leads the Task Force to uncover a security breach within the US government. Congressman Hudson takes major steps to uncover the inner workings of the Task Force.

videos.title: Arthur Hudson
videos.overview: Cooper is caught on the defensive when summoned by the Attorney General. Red visits dear friends.

videos.title: Raymond Reddington (1)
videos.overview: It's the task force versus Hudson and his agents as they chase down Red — who stays one step ahead of them. Zuma's transgression is caught on camera.

videos.title: Raymond Reddington: Good Night (2)
videos.overview: The future of the FBI's Reddington Task Force is decided.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 3 wins & 33 nominations total
